  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the BR-issued card is used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception is needed. No earlier outcome settles this order under §6.3. The victim report does not establish unauthorized use of this order or independently trigger Account access. A legitimate customer using a longstanding foreign-issued card remains plausible, but familiarity does not verify the purchaser. With no completed checks, §6.6(b) permits needs_check and prohibits decline with this sole family. Recommend holding the unshipped order for id_check, which establishes possession of the card and account identity. Contact is not required by the present family."
